description: This PHP class file defines a Config class within the OrangeHRM application, managing configuration settings and constants such as directory paths, modes, and features flags. It includes static methods for retrieving, setting, and managing configuration variables, as well as handling external dependencies like the Conf class and configuration files.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: A static utility class for managing application configuration constants and settings, including handling external configuration files and providing accessors for configuration data.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieve a configuration value by name, with optional default.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Check if a configuration key exists.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Set a configuration key to a specified value.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Merge an array of configurations into existing configs.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Check if the configuration system is properly initialized and installed.

methods.name: getConf
methods.description: Load and retrieve the external configuration object, possibly including the configuration file.
